limits: Both runs ended at the 180-second watchdog; no host input or image capture.
Native header hooks observe, never alter guest descriptors or headers; outputs cap at 400 descriptors / 2000 rows.
The small-stock descriptor inventory is static. Other runtime headers are compared by descriptor fields, without claiming exact named asset attribution.
Same 22.5333-second snapshots and camera do not prove identical simulation/animation phase throughout both runs.

Filtered scanline samples change at all 4800 measured points (previous 4157), peak RGB increment 0.32549 (previous 0.39608), but total brightness/saturation rises; this is not a readability acceptance.
The converter output is byte-exact to the tested map resources, including native address fixups. A full scenario rebuild was not attempted amid unrelated pending conversion edits.
Source curve, pixels, shader constants, animation, original gameplay, geometry and stock assets remain unchanged.
No physical Xbox 360/system-link or current performance acceptance; no release promotion. Original black flash and protrusion lighting still require diagnosis.
